title: Rightward input head position
statement: Let $n,r\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $p$ be one of the $n+2$ input-head positions. If $p+r\le n+1$, then moving the head one position to the right, with boundary clamping, $r$ times from $p$ yields position $p+r$.
